title: Silkworm
description: A fabric-based library developed to support mods by okipiak.
body:
🧵 Silkworm 🐛

A fabric-based library developed to support mods by okipiak.

Links

- 💾 GitHub Repository (in progress) – source code. - 🪲 Issues – report bugs.

Overview

Silkworm is a library built for Minecraft mod development. It provides a collection of utility functions, common hooks, and reusable components to help streamline mod creation and reduce boilerplate. This library is primarily developed for my own projects and is:
  • ❌ Not documented
  • ❌ Not intended for general public use

Notes

- I've changed the name from **"SalvaLib"** to **"Silkworm"**. for versions above 1.0. - Internal utility library powering mods like okipiak’s Shelf and Chrysalia. - Possible public release in the future if documentation and stability improve.
